packageRules.description: Upstream images are pinned to full PATCH tags in the Dockerfile (see bar-assistant/CLAUDE.md 'Versioning'), so every upstream release -- major, minor, and patch -- surfaces as a PR. Each still requires a coupled bump of the 5-part add-on version + Dockerfile LABEL, which no bot can do unattended, so they are flagged for the maintainer.
prBodyNotes: :warning: This bumps an upstream tag. Before merging, update the coupled fields per bar-assistant/CLAUDE.md 'Versioning': `config.yaml` `version:` (a major/minor move updates the matching field, a patch move bumps `<pkg>`), the Dockerfile `io.hass.version` LABEL, and confirm `scripts/check-version-sync.sh` passes.

packageRules.description: Collect every update into ONE grouped PR per weekly run (see top-level `schedule`). Kept LAST so its groupName wins for all deps (Renovate applies matching rules in order, last write wins), funneling GitHub Actions, the upstream images, and everything else config:recommended tracks into a single branch/PR. The per-dep labels and the upstream version-bump warning above still apply -- addLabels/prBodyNotes append across matching rules -- so a coupled upstream MINOR/MAJOR move stays flagged (`needs-version-bump`) even inside the combined PR.

customManagers.description: Track the ARG BUILD_FROM default tag (the dockerfile manager only reads FROM lines, not ARG defaults).

Track the version-pinned CI runner images (both amd64 `ubuntu-24.04` and arm64 `ubuntu-24.04-arm`). The github-runners manager only reads literal `runs-on:` values, not labels carried in `strategy.matrix` and referenced via `runs-on: ${{ matrix.runner }}`, so the pins are matched here instead. Docker versioning keeps each on its own stream (the `-arm` variant upgrades to `-arm`, the plain one to plain).
